user_summary_md:
## Your Situation

You are a first-time investor with **$300/month** to invest. You have no existing portfolio — which is a strong starting position. The key is to build habits and stay invested.

Macro context: CPI at 3.2%, index markets moderately valued. Good time to start a regular investment programme.
portfolio_diagnosis_md: No existing portfolio. Financial readiness: good — you have monthly investable capacity and a clear goal. Starting now with dollar-cost averaging into low-cost index funds is the textbook approach.

options.title: Safety First Foundation
options.best_for: Users who want to build an emergency buffer before market exposure
options.content_md:
### Asset Allocation
| Asset | Allocation | Monthly |
|---|---|---|
| Emergency fund (HYSA) | 50% | $150 |
| Broad index fund (VOO) | 40% | $120 |
| Cash | 10% | $30 |

### Why this works
Builds a safety net first. Emergency fund is 3 months of expenses.

### Pros
- Low stress, builds safety
- Slow and steady

### Cons
- Slower wealth growth

### Agent guidance
Choose this if you don't yet have 3 months of expenses saved.

options.title: Balanced Beginner Start
options.best_for: Stable income earners with 5+ year horizon
options.content_md:
### Asset Allocation
| Asset | Allocation | Monthly |
|---|---|---|
| Equity index (FXAIX, 0.015% ER) | 70% | $210 |
| Bond ETF (BND) | 20% | $60 |
| Cash | 10% | $30 |

### Why this works
70/30 classic split. Good growth with bond cushion.

### Pros
- Simple, diversified
- Low cost

### Cons
- Some market fluctuation expected

### Agent guidance
Textbook first-investor strategy.

options.title: Long-Term Growth Path
options.best_for: 10+ year horizon, can accept short-term volatility
options.content_md:
### Asset Allocation
| Asset | Allocation | Monthly |
|---|---|---|
| Total market index (VTI, 0.03% ER) | 90% | $270 |
| Cash | 10% | $30 |

### Why this works
Full equity for maximum long-term compounding.

### Pros
- Highest expected long-term return
- Extremely low cost

### Cons
- High short-term volatility

### Agent guidance
Only if you won't panic-sell on a 30% drop.

hidden_disclosures: STCG tax applies if any equity sold within 12 months.
